title: EXAMINING AI-GENERATED HISTORICAL NARRATIVES AND THEIR RECEPTION THROUGH THE EXAMPLE OF HISTORY POVS ON TIKTOK
reasoning: The paper includes a classification dimension specifically for 'social_or_moral_commentary', which it defines as expressing social observation, critique, or ethical/moral judgment. It analyzes how different historical topics (like the Holocaust) elicit these types of moral statements and evaluate the performance of an NLP model in detecting these ethical and moral categories in human discourse.
